content.contents: finishing up a lot of work! album is 90% done, just a couple tracks left to master and one needs to be mixed a tad better. this is gonna be a big release y'all. i don't wanna spoil anything but uh, fans of physical media... get hype, that's all i'm gonna say. i've also got a collab EP coming out some time in october, at a very spooky time indeed...

things have been better recently. i've been attending more therapy, and getting some trauma counselling, i've been officially diagnosed with ADHD here in the UK which means i can access medication soon (hopefully), and i've actually been able to work on my music without doubting my abilities constantly!

i've also started estrogen patches - i was on pills, then injections, then pills again, now i'm on patches. i think my shithead doctor might've lowered my dose some more but he's retiring at the end of the month so i'm praying my next GP is a bit more open-minded. i feel good about patches though, i've heard and read good things.

i'm gonna be on a fair few compilation albums coming up too, so keep a look out for those. i hope y'all have been enjoying the collabs that've been slowly but surely releasing, i worked hard on all of that over summer so to see it all begin to release is really exciting!

what else have i been up to... let's see, recently i've been really into this mario64 romhack called b3313, it's pretty popular so some of you 4 or 5 people who maybe read these blogs might know of it. definitely worth a playthrough, there's nothing out there like it that i've played. it really bends your mind in an endearing way, and to be honest i'd say it's better experienced than described or watched. i made the mistake of watching a couple of streamers play it beforehand and it spoiled a fair amount of fuckery. there's a lot of original music in the hack too, much of which i find to be really enjoyable. i don't really know the names of the tracks or hubs pertained to said tracks, but there's one hub that's very orange with a nice waltz somewhat reminiscent of Satie's Gymnopedie no. 1 that i adore! it puts me in a good mood every time i wander in there. some of the 'horror' elements are a little bit cheesy but some areas (such as what i think is called 'polygonal chaos') really do well to create a general malaise or unsettling atmosphere. overall it by all means gets the static seal of approval, which is worth maybe a nickel at most.
let's talk some about this upcoming album!

this is my first actual album album, and not just a compilation of bullshit (like SFI was). what do i mean by album-album? well, the way i like to approach albums is more conceptual than your average smattering of tracks (of course, there's nothing wrong with this type of album, mind you). when i start writing an album i like to kind of develop mental mood-boards and general concepts, ideas, themes that i want to be explored across it. this one is called GO UNTIL YOU ARE GONE 2013.04-07, which may seem to be a weird title, but there's meaning to it.

of course, i don't want to spoil too much meaning before the album comes out, but i've been working closely with the artist Chocoa (who has drawn an amazing collection of pieces themed around the album!) and we both came up with the latter part of the title, 2013.04-07, because some very significant paradigm shift-inducing life changes occurred for both of us in this year. GO UNTIL YOU ARE GONE, well, you'll maybe come to find the meaning when the album is released. and, if you don't, i'll probably talk ad nauseum about the album's concepts and meanings when it's released so, don't fret.

the album will consist of 10 tracks, 2 of which have already been released (nothing will ever be enough (1), and girls in my dreams are made up of static interference). i plan to release a couple more before the album comes out because of course, the industry dictates that the consumer wishes only for rapid-fire content, and who the hell has the time or attention span to sit and listen to a full album-long experience these days to gain perspective of a narrative when we have access to unlimited dopamine injected right into our minds at all times? :3
not much else to report really.
here, have some artwork from a recent soundcloud single that'll be on an upcoming compilation album!
the little sticky-note doodle was drawn by yours truly. i'm not great at drawing but it sure is fun.
